v: Know what makes people keep watching
Pick the kind of videos you will make

b.v: About 20 minutes. Any phone camera and a free editing app are enough.

On short video feeds people decide in about 3 seconds whether to keep watching. Start with the most interesting moment, a question, or the result - never with 'Assalam o alaikum friends, today in this video...'.

v: How-to and tips - 'Fix a slow phone in 3 steps'
Before and after - a room, a dish, a design
Behind the scenes - how you make your product
Story - a short real experience with a lesson
Answers - reply to a question people often ask

b.v: A 30 to 60 second video can hold one idea well. If you have five tips, that is five videos, not one long one.
Do this now:|Write 10 video ideas for your topic or business.|Mark the 3 you could film this week.

day-2.t: Day 2 — Planning: script and shot list

v: Write a simple script
List the shots before you film

b.v: Step by step:|Hook (0-3 s) - the result or a question|Point (3-20 s) - the main tip or story|Proof (20-40 s) - show it working|Action (last 5 s) - follow, comment, message, visit

v: Wide shot - where you are
Medium shot - you talking
Close-ups - hands, product, screen
A few extra 'B-roll' shots to cut to while you speak

b.v: Read your script out loud. If a sentence is hard to say, shorten it. Simple words, short sentences, Urdu, English or both - whatever your viewers speak.
Do this now:|Choose one idea from Day 1.|Write the 4-part script in under 100 words.|List 6 shots you need.

v: Shoot clean, bright, steady video
Frame people well
Face a window - daylight on your face, never behind you
Avoid harsh midday sun on faces; shade or morning light is softer
At night, one lamp in front of you beats the ceiling light above
Vertical (tall) for short video feeds, horizontal for long videos
Eyes about one third from the top of the frame
Clean background - no mess, no bright window behind you
Clean the lens before every shoot
Use a cheap tripod or lean the phone against books
Hold with both hands and elbows against your body
Move slowly - fast moves look shaky

b.v: Do this now:|Film the same 10-second sentence in three places in your home.|Watch them and pick the best light.|Use that spot for all your videos.

v: Record clear voice
Remove the noise you can control

b.v: People forgive average video, but they leave quickly if they cannot hear clearly. Bad sound is the number one reason beginner videos are skipped.

v: Film close to the phone - one arm's length or nearer
Small rooms with curtains, beds and carpets sound better than empty rooms
Turn off fans and AC for the take
A cheap clip-on microphone makes a big difference

b.v: For tutorials, you can film the screen or your hands and record the voice later in a quiet room, then put them together in editing.
Do this now:|Record the same sentence: phone far away, then close.|Record once with the fan on, once off.|Listen with earphones and note the difference.

v: Cut out everything boring
Use jump cuts and B-roll

b.v: About 20 minutes. Use any free phone editor with a timeline.

v: Remove 'umm', pauses and repeated sentences
Start on the first interesting word
If a part does not help the one idea, cut it

b.v: A jump cut joins two parts of you talking with the middle removed - it keeps the pace fast. To hide a cut, place a B-roll clip (close-up, product, screen) over it.
Watch your edit at normal speed. If you feel like skipping any second, your viewers will too. Cut it.
Most good short videos change the shot every 2 to 4 seconds.
Do this now:|Edit yesterday's practice clips into one 30-second video.|Cut at least 30% of the raw footage.|Add 2 B-roll shots over the cuts.

v: Add readable on-screen text
Add subtitles for viewers watching without sound

b.v: In buses, offices and at night many people watch without sound. Subtitles keep them watching and help people who are hard of hearing.

v: Many editing apps have automatic captions - always check the spelling
XpertCreation's Video Translate writes subtitles in Urdu, English, Punjabi and more, and gives you an .srt file
Keep lines short - 1 or 2 lines on screen at a time
Big, bold, high contrast
Keep it in the middle safe area - top and bottom get covered by buttons
Same font and colour in every video

b.v: Do this now:|Add subtitles to your 30-second video.|Watch it on mute - can you follow everything?|Fix any wrong words.

v: Use music you are allowed to use
Mix music under your voice

b.v: Songs from films, singers and dramas belong to someone. Using them can get your video muted, removed or your account given a strike - even if you bought the song.

v: The music library inside the app you post to (allowed only on that app)
Royalty-free music sites that clearly allow commercial use - read the licence
Music you made yourself or with written permission
Music much quieter than your voice - you should hear every word easily
Lower the music more while you speak
Short sound effects (a click, a whoosh) for key moments, not all the time

b.v: 'No copyright intended' written in the description does not make it legal. Only permission does.
Do this now:|Add a royalty-free track to your video.|Set it low under your voice.|Listen with earphones and adjust.

v: Make a thumbnail that gets clicks honestly
Write clear titles
One clear face or object, close up
3 to 5 big words at most
High contrast colours
Consistent style so people recognise your channel
Say exactly what they will get: 'Make chicken karahi in 20 minutes'
Put the key words first - they help search
Do not promise what the video does not deliver

b.v: Misleading thumbnails get clicks once and lose followers forever. Platforms also push down videos people leave quickly.
Do this now:|Make a thumbnail at 1280 x 720 for a long video, or a cover for a short one.|Write 3 titles and pick the clearest.

v: Post at the right time
Learn from the numbers

b.v: Three videos a week every week grows faster than ten in one week and then nothing for a month. Pick days you can keep.

v: Watch time and how many watch to the end - the most important
Where people stop watching - fix that part next time
Comments and shares - what people really cared about
Reply to comments in the first hour
Turn good questions into your next video
Go live sometimes - XpertConnect has Go Live built in

b.v: Do this now:|Post your practice video.|After 2 days, find where people stopped watching.|Write one change for your next video.

v: Make one complete, polished video
Plan your next month

b.v: Step by step:|Idea - one clear idea (Day 1)|Script - hook, point, proof, action (Day 2)|Film - window light, steady, clean background (Day 3)|Sound - close, quiet room (Day 4)|Edit - cut hard, B-roll (Day 5)|Subtitles - checked spelling (Day 6)|Music - legal, low under voice (Day 7)|Thumbnail and title - honest and clear (Day 8)

v: Week 1-4: 3 videos a week from your idea list
Every Sunday: check the numbers and choose one improvement
